_about: Known failure modes of OpenEdge runs. signature: regex matched against logs/stdout/stderr. check: preflight check that detects it before a run. Keep entries free of names, private paths and unpublished results.

entries.title: Process database missing, unreadable or not HDF5
entries.cause: The binary reads database/processes.h5 from $OPENEDGE_ROOT/database, else the directory compiled into the binary. A binary built in another tree, or a moved checkout, points elsewhere.
entries.fix: Set OPENEDGE_ROOT to the OpenEdge directory whose database/ holds processes.h5, or rebuild in this tree. `openedge-agent preflight` reports which database the binary will read.

entries.title: Reflection table not in the database
entries.cause: A `T <pair>` line of the recycle file names a pair without /surface/reflection/<pair> in processes.h5. Absent reflection tables stop the run.
entries.fix: Use a projectile/target pair the database holds (`openedge-agent db --list reflection`), or add the table with database/ingest.

entries.title: Sputter yield falls back to the analytic model
entries.cause: A `S <pair>` line names a pair without /surface/sputter/<pair>. The run continues with the analytic yield, which is unreliable at grazing incidence.
entries.fix: Add the table (tools/converters/add_sputter_tables.py) or accept the analytic model knowingly.

entries.title: Table present but unusable
entries.cause: A table exists but has wrong dimensions or a missing axis. Since 7054121 this stops the run instead of falling back to the analytic model.
entries.fix: Regenerate the table (tools/converters/add_sputter_tables.py).

entries.title: No volume reactions for an element
entries.cause: fix volume/chem/adas names an element without /volume/reactions/<element> in processes.h5 and without database/ingest/reactions/<element>.reactions.
entries.fix: Use an element the database holds or give the path of a .reactions file.

entries.title: Style not in this binary
entries.cause: The deck uses a style the binary was not built with: binary older than the deck, or the OPENEDGE package not installed.
entries.fix: Build from a commit that has the style, with PKG_OPENEDGE on.

entries.title: fix dt/monitor defined before fix volume/chem/adas
entries.signature: Fix dt/monitor must be defined after fix volume/chem/adas
entries.cause: The monitor attaches to the chemistry fixes that exist when it is created.
entries.fix: Move the fix dt/monitor line after every fix volume/chem/adas.

entries.title: Settings counted in steps not rescaled when the timestep changes
entries.cause: Operator intervals (Nevery of physics fixes, emission nevery, adens_nevery, population control, core coupling) are counted in steps. Changing dt alone changes their physical interval, so two runs differ in more than the timestep.
entries.fix: Compare with `openedge-agent preflight --reference-var dt=<old>`; rescale every physics setting so its physical interval is unchanged, or state that it changes.

entries.title: Result depends on the timestep
entries.cause: Several operators are first order in dt or worse. A run that finishes cleanly is not shown to be converged until a run at half the step agrees.
entries.fix: Before a long run, run the same short interval at dt and dt/2 (same physical time, rescaled step settings) and compare the key outputs.

entries.title: Gyromotion under-resolved
entries.signature: orbit resolution limit exceeded|OpenEdge Boris warning
entries.cause: |q/m||B|dt_sub above the advisory limit for some charged species.
entries.fix: Raise global pusher subcycles to the number the warning gives, or reduce dt.

entries.title: Reaction probability per update too large
entries.cause: rate x interval of fix volume/chem/adas above 0.1: several reactions per update are folded into one.
entries.fix: Reduce dt or the Nevery of fix volume/chem/adas; subcycles do not help.

entries.title: Emission nevery changed meaning (8ffdc1f)
entries.cause: Since 8ffdc1f, nevery of fix surface/emit/source is the source evaluation window and the window's markers are released over its steps. Older binaries released them in one batch, which biased prompt redeposition. Runs from the two binaries do not reproduce marker for marker.
entries.fix: Use a binary at or after 8ffdc1f; do not mix results across the change without saying so.

entries.title: Wall ledger reduced every step
entries.cause: surf_react surface/pwi folds its ledger every adens_nevery steps with a global reduction. The default 1 can dominate runtime on many ranks.
entries.fix: Set adens_nevery 100 (or larger) in MPI decks; check that the concentration update interval is still short against the physics.

entries.title: Bursts from population control weights
entries.cause: fix population/control keeps random survivors per (cell, species) and scales their weight up. Repeated passes compound weights; a few heavy markers then produce jumps in content and wall fluxes.
entries.fix: Watch max/mean marker weight and the effective sample size in the output; increase Nmax or reduce the pass frequency if they degrade.

entries.title: Cross-field diffusion step near walls (open item)
entries.cause: fix cross_field_diffusion applies a random step sqrt(2 D_perp dt) up to the wall. Where that step is comparable to the sheath scale, wall-loop results can depend on dt. Under investigation.
entries.fix: Include a dt/2 comparison with and without cross-field diffusion before relying on wall-loop quantities.

entries.title: MPI_Init fails in the UCX layer
entries.cause: Some clusters' UCX transport fails at start-up on some nodes.
entries.fix: Use the shared-memory/TCP transports set in the machine profile (for Open MPI: OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1, OMPI_MCA_btl=self,vader,tcp).

entries.title: Memory grows until the job is killed
entries.cause: With Open MPI ob1+vader, the single-copy mechanism leaked a few kB per rank per collective on one cluster, killing long runs.
entries.fix: Set OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none in the machine profile; watch resident memory in the first hour.

entries.title: Run started from another directory
entries.cause: Relative paths in a deck resolve against the directory the binary is started in.
entries.fix: Start the run in the case directory (openedge-agent does this).

entries.title: Edited default ignored
entries.cause: index-style variables are not redefined: a -var on the command line wins over the deck, and a later index definition of the same name is ignored.
entries.fix: Check the effective values with `openedge-agent inspect` using the same -var arguments as the run.

entries.title: GPU runs are not reproducible marker for marker
entries.cause: The device random stream differs from the CPU stream and between runs, so identical-particle comparisons cannot pass on GPU.
entries.fix: Compare GPU and CPU statistically (several seeds), not particle by particle.
